engineeringSkip.reason: A buzzword mash-up with no real research programme: there is no known physics or fabrication route for embedding circuitry into the atomic structure of arbitrary objects, and 'Total Object Awareness' describes an aspiration rather than a technology.

factCheck.reason: It is a vague buzzword mash-up — 'atomic-structure circuitry' and 'total object awareness' describe no real mechanism, and assembling working computers atom-by-atom inside ordinary printed objects is not something known physics or manufacturing allows.
